message: Turn 38 fixed at 580797cf509c5509a271c3f58d6f6de093edbd05, Dispatcher 2.2.11. Changed files: .agent-handoff/dispatcher.py, .agent-handoff/dispatcher-runtime.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_bootstrap.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_page.py, .agent-handoff/test_signal_fetch.py. Installer unchanged and still version-dynamic. Tests: python3 -m py_compile dispatcher.py dispatcher-runtime.py test_control_bootstrap.py test_control_page.py test_signal_fetch.py exit 0; python3 test_control_page.py printed test_control_page: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_bootstrap.py printed test_control_bootstrap: OK and inferTurnRole: OK, exit 0; python3 test_signal_fetch.py printed test_signal_fetch: OK, exit 0. Semantics: /c/WEB:<uuid> and /c/<uuid> match as the same conversation, but the saved URL remains the observed page URL. An already-open equivalent page is used with no goto. If none is equivalent, other open conversation pages are read-only checked for the bootstrap marker, CONTROL READY, or the pending wake, and a proven page is selected without navigating it. Only when no candidate is proven is a new page created and opened at the saved URL. An unrelated ChatGPT conversation is never navigated. Selecting an equivalent or proven page canonicalizes the saved URL in one write and preserves bootstrap_sent_at, recovery_used, recovery_reason, and recovered_from. The one-recovery latch, no bootstrap resend, 2.2.10 raw-to-api failover, CHECK_INTERVAL, and wake de-duplication are unchanged. Logs do not include message text. main and arena/local-agent-v0 were not modified. Phase 2 and live mailbox were not enabled.
